Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the application of the public records act to persons working or serving sentences at correctional facilities and criminal justice agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the application of public records act to personsworking or serving sentences at correctional facilities and criminaljustice agencies; and adding new sections to chapter 42.56 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The inspection or copying of any nonexemptpublic record by persons serving criminal sentences in state, local, orprivately operated correctional facilities is prohibited under thischapter.

(1) In addition to any other exemptionsunder this chapter, including RCW 42.56.250, criminal justicefacilities and agencies are prohibited from releasing personalinformation for any employee, former employee, dependent of an employeeor a former employee, or former spouse with custody of an employee ora former employee's dependents, including: (a) Photographs; (b) Residential addresses; (c) Residential telephone numbers; (d) Personal wireless telephone numbers; p. 1 HB 2259 (e) Personal email addresses; (f) Social security numbers; and (g) Dates of birth. (2) Information exempted from disclosure under subsection (1) ofthis section may be disclosed only through a court order if it ismaterial evidence in a pending civil or criminal action.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act are each addedto chapter 42.56 RCW.
